description: This Java class implements the HookReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve and manage hook configurations, templates, and events within the system. It interacts with the database using JdbcTemplate and leverages Spring annotations for caching and dependency injection.

classes.name: HookReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the HookReadPlatformService interface for reading hook-related data from the database.

classes.name: HookMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping SQL result set rows to HookData objects.

classes.name: HookEventMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping event data related to hooks.

classes.name: HookConfigMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping hook configuration fields.

classes.name: TemplateMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping hook template data.

classes.name: TemplateSchemaMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping schema fields within hook templates.

methods.name: retrieveAllHooks
methods.description: Retrieves all hooks from the database, ordered by name.

methods.name: retrieveHook
methods.description: Retrieves a specific hook by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveHooksByEvent
methods.description: Retrieves hooks listening to a specific event, identified by entity and action names.

methods.name: retrieveNewHookDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details for creating a new hook, optionally filtered by template name.
